# Fourth

## Overview

- **Age:** fourteen (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057), [v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064)</sub>
- **Role:** handmaiden (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Fourth is known to style her hair in a variety of ways, ranging from innumerable plaits wound around her head with the white-thread ends sticking out in all directions, to two crinkly tails secured with four bright blue ribbons. She wears a white dress that is so stiffly starched it can stand on its own.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0022), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P27](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Fourth is a warm-hearted little handmaiden who shows genuine care and devotion toward others. She is honestly worried over her adored mistress' condition.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

As an orphan, Fourth spent their early childhood moving between different homes to look after children. They were eventually sent to live in an asylum. When asked about their past, Fourth recounted this history of neglect, inspiring deep pity in their listener.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--fourth.md)

Fourth is a close acquaintance of [Anne](../character/anne.md) and serves alongside her as an assistant at a wedding. During a drive to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Anne](../character/anne.md) confided her painful childhood history as an orphan to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), inspiring pity that led to her remaining at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Fourth maintains a friendly bond with [Anne](../character/anne.md) as her peer in their shared social circle.

- Friend of — close acquaintance and assistant at wedding (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)</sub>

### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--fourth.md)

Fourth and [Diana](../character/diana.md) share a close friendship within their social group. Along with [Anne](../character/anne.md), Fourth works alongside [Diana](../character/diana.md) as an assistant during a wedding, cementing their cooperative and friendly association.

- Friend of — close acquaintance and assistant at wedding (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fourth--lavendar-lewis.md)

Fourth serves under Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), maintaining a household relationship defined by her duties. Her dynamic with [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) involves supporting the older woman in her home, positioning Fourth as a domestic subordinate.

- Serves under (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
